summary: Iteration 7b verification — PRIMARY FIX from iter7 (section-card rendering for long-form) is now PASSING. Long-form result renders all 7 expected section cards (concept/hooks/outline/script/transitions/broll/notes) inside [data-testid='scripts-output'] with markdown <strong> rendered and no literal '**' leaking into the text. copyAll() also correctly emits 'Copied entire script.' in headless via the new execCommand fallback. Opening a long-form job from history also re-populates the 7 section cards. NEW SHORTS BUG FOUND: phone-beat-hook/body/cta blocks are missing because Claude wraps the bracket markers in markdown bold (e.g. '**[HOOK — 0:00–0:03]**') and ShortPhoneBody's regex requires the bracket to be alone on the line — the phone column ends up empty.

ui_bugs.issue: Phone-frame center column renders empty for shorts results. Cause: Claude consistently emits the beat markers wrapped in markdown bold ('**[HOOK — 0:00–0:03]**', '**[BODY — 0:03–0:50]**', '**[CTA — 0:51–0:58]**') inside the SHORT-FORM SCRIPT section, but ShortPhoneBody's bracket-detector regex /^\s*\[(HOOK|BODY|CTA)([^\]]*)\]\s*$/i requires the bracket to be alone on the line — no leading/trailing '**'. Result: phone-body element exists but contains no phone-beat-* children, so the TikTok/Reels phone frame is visibly blank (verified via screenshot on existing shorts job 6473d5dd-8814-45b9-91a1-970712a207ae and a fresh shorts gen). Plan/Distribute columns (hooks, caption, hashtags, broll, notes, on-screen, title variants, cover prompts) all render correctly.
ui_bugs.suggested_fix: Strip leading/trailing '**' (and any other markdown emphasis) from each line in ShortPhoneBody before the bracket regex test. Two-liner: `const stripped = ln.replace(/^\s*\*\*(.+?)\*\*\s*$/,'$1');` then run the bracket regex on stripped. Alternatively, broaden the regex to `/^\s*(?:\*\*)?\[(HOOK|BODY|CTA)([^\]]*)\](?:\*\*)?\s*$/i`. Either fix is mechanical and should be paired with a unit test in parser.test.cjs using a SAMPLE_BOLD_BRACKET fixture.

action_items: HIGH: Fix ShortPhoneBody in /app/frontend/src/pages/Scripts.jsx to strip leading/trailing '**' from each line before the bracket-marker regex. Without this, every shorts result renders with an empty phone frame — the centerpiece of the shorts experience. Recommended fix is a 1-line .replace(/^(\s*)\*\*\s*(\[.+?\])\s*\*\*(\s*)$/,'$1$2$3') applied to each line before the existing regex test, OR broaden the regex itself to optionally consume surrounding '**'. Add a unit test in parser.test.cjs covering '**[HOOK — 0:00–0:03]**'.
critical_code_review_comments: ShortPhoneBody and parseSections both have to defend against Claude's markdown-bold habit (parser.js already strips '**' inside extractNarration). Consider a shared `stripMarkdownEmphasis` helper in /app/frontend/src/utils/parser.js so the rules stay in sync — the long-form parser fix in iter7b addressed this for headings, but the shorts beat-marker parser missed the same treatment.

Scripts.jsx is now ~785 lines including ShortPhoneBody, SectionCard, AngleCard, SkeletonCard, and the main Scripts component. Recommend extracting the three card components and ShortPhoneBody into /app/frontend/src/components/scripts/ to bring the page file under 500 lines (per the >700-line guideline).

copyAll() now has a proper execCommand fallback — nice. Consider also calling document.queryCommandSupported('copy') before showing the failure toast, so SSR/older browsers can degrade more gracefully.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Long-form rendering bug from iter7 is RESOLVED — confirmed via fresh gen + history reopen. The ONLY remaining issue is the shorts phone-frame: ShortPhoneBody can't detect '**[HOOK — ...]**' markers because they're wrapped in markdown bold. Repro: open any shorts job from history (e.g. id=f2f48-video-engine for drcharitycampbell), look at the center column — phone-body exists but contains zero phone-beat-* children. Fetching the raw text from /api/scripts/job/{id} confirms the SHORT-FORM SCRIPT section uses '**[HOOK — 0:00–0:03]**' etc. as standalone lines wrapped in markdown emphasis.
rca of the issue: Iter7 RCA was correct that the parser was rejecting non-### headings; iter7b's parser fix is verified working. The newly-found shorts bug is a SEPARATE, pre-existing issue (not introduced by iter7b) — ShortPhoneBody.lines[].match() never strips markdown emphasis before testing the bracket pattern, so any time Claude emits '**[HOOK — ...]**' (which it does ~100% of the time given the FACE48 shorts prompt template), the phone column renders empty. Mitigation: strip leading/trailing '**' from each line before the regex test, OR broaden the regex to optionally consume surrounding '**'. Both are 1-line fixes.
